selection_priority_rules: MUST / MUST_NOT / NEVER / ONLY / REQUIRED rows
Rows likely to expose enforcement blind spots not covered by Tier 0-3

selected.requirement_text: Every runtime invocation MUST bind an Authority Context resolved against the Authority Registry; unbound or unresolved authority MUST be rejected before any L0..L4 effect.
selected.why_tier4: Authority binding is the substrate every other governance gate sits on. Without a Tier 4 bind on the registry-binding step, an unbound run can defeat L5 cert, capability tokens, guardrails, and UWG sovereignty.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for authority_bypass.

selected.requirement_text: Each runtime exit packet MUST carry a Runtime Certification binding to an L5-issued cert; missing or stale certs MUST block exit.
selected.why_tier4: Runtime cert binding closes the loop between L5 governance and Exit. Tier 0..3 do not assert the cert is bound to the run; this row is the next blind spot.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for gate_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: All guardrail families declared in the L5 spec MUST be loaded and applied before any runtime invocation; missing families MUST block.
selected.why_tier4: Guardrail family coverage is policy-bedrock. Tier 0..3 assert L5 anti-bypass and cert presence but not family completeness.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for policy_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: Governance context MUST be invariant across L1..Exit for a single runtime invocation; any drift MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Governance-context drift is a silent-mutation class not yet tier-protected.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for state_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: UWG durable writes MUST occur only with an invariant Authority + Governance + Tenant context; any mismatch MUST block the write.
selected.why_tier4: Tier 0 covers UWG sovereignty but not the per-write context-invariant. Authority drift across a write boundary is the residual risk.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for write_sovereignty.

selected.requirement_text: Policy blueprint and registry state MUST be deterministic, versioned, and read-only at runtime; any mutation MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Policy blueprint mutation is a silent-policy-drift surface not covered by Tier 0..3.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for state_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: The Runtime Gates layer-invocation map MUST cover every L0..L6 gate insertion point; missing entries MUST fail closed.
selected.why_tier4: Coverage of the gate map itself is the Tier 4 audit closure for runtime gates.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for gate_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: U0 intake MUST resolve and seal Identity, Tenant, and Session before any L1 handoff; unresolved triples MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Identity/tenant/session is the upstream basis for every authority and quota check. Tier 3 covers channel validation only.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for identity_quota_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: Quota baselines MUST be sealed at U0 and immutable through the run; quota mutation downstream MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Quota mutation is a downstream-cheating surface not yet tier-protected.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for identity_quota_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: U0 intake MUST normalize request schema and enforce idempotency; non-idempotent or non-normalized requests MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Schema-drift at intake corrupts every downstream evidence claim.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for schema_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: L1 MUST emit an Intent Frame and Ambiguity Register before drafting a plan; missing intent frame MUST block plan emission.
selected.why_tier4: Tier 3 covers ambiguity evidence but not the intent frame itself.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for planning_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: Planning priors / rule bundle MUST be deterministic and bound to the Intent Frame; prior drift MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Prior-drift is a silent-policy class above the existing L1 plan-validation row.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for planning_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: L0 MUST run route-input preflight before any L1 handoff; preflight failures MUST reject the route.
selected.why_tier4: Preflight is the first runtime guard at L0; Tier 0..3 assert no-execute and grounded handoff but not preflight.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for intake_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: L0 cache, fallback, and HITL routes MUST be explicit and policy-bound; ad-hoc fallbacks MUST be blocked.
selected.why_tier4: Fallback paths are a known authority-bypass surface; Tier 4 closes the audit for cache/fallback/HITL.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for cache_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: Every RouteContract MUST emit deterministic telemetry and replay evidence; missing telemetry MUST block exit.
selected.why_tier4: Replay-integrity for L0 RouteContract is the audit bedrock for end-to-end route reproduction.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for replay_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: L3 managed-workflow eligibility and DAG MUST be policy-bound; ineligible workflows MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: L3 managed-workflow gating is not yet tier-protected.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for orchestration_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: C0 retrieval plan MUST be deterministic and bound to the Intent Frame; ad-hoc retrievals MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Retrieval-plan determinism is the upstream of Tier 3's graph-RAG bounds row.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for retrieval_boundary.

selected.requirement_text: PA MUST load and resolve the prompt BOM with version-pinned dependencies; unpinned or unresolved BOMs MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: BOM determinism is the prompt-assembly bedrock; Tier 3 covers slot contract violation only.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for prompt_boundary.

selected.requirement_text: PA token-budget allocation MUST be deterministic and bounded; non-deterministic budgets MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Token-budget drift is a silent prompt-mutation surface.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for prompt_boundary.

selected.requirement_text: L2 E1 prep MUST seal a Frozen Execution Room before any tool invocation; mutation after seal MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Frozen-room seal is the tool-execution sandbox bedrock.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for sandbox_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: L2 E5 MUST seal the artifact and dispatch atomically; partial dispatch MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Seal+dispatch atomicity prevents partial-write corruption.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for artifact_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: L2 Sequencer / Orchestrator contract MUST be deterministic and traceable; non-deterministic sequencing MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Sequencer determinism is the L2 audit bedrock.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for orchestration_integrity.

selected.requirement_text: Exit HITL freeze MUST suspend all downstream effects until reclearance; bypass MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: HITL freeze is the human-in-loop kill switch; bypass is a release-blocking class.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for output_disposition.

selected.requirement_text: L6 MUST ingest runtime exhaust deterministically and normalize into the regression dataset; lossy ingest MUST be rejected.
selected.why_tier4: Lossy exhaust-ingest defeats the runtime-to-regression flow.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for audit_traceability.

selected.requirement_text: E2E proof MUST demonstrate evidence/prompt/output groundedness end-to-end; missing groundedness MUST block proof.
selected.why_tier4: Groundedness proof is the end-to-end audit bedrock; Tier 3 covers replay-harness boundary only.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Static reference module + deterministic trace + replay pair + negative-control fixture + targeted fixture test for proof_false_confidence.
